seo.title: Contact Us: Software Company in Dhaka
seo.description: Contact Spectrum IT Solutions in Dhaka about a new project, a tender, a product quote or support for a live system. We reply within one business day.

hero.title: Get *in touch*
hero.lead: Tell us about your project, ask for a demo, or get help with a system we run for you. Our team is in Dhaka and replies within one business day.

reasons.title: Partnerships

items.title: We reply
items.text: Within one business day, by email or phone, whichever you gave us.

items.title: A short call
items.text: We ask a few questions to understand what you need, who will use it and your timeline.

items.title: Demo or proposal
items.text: We show you a working demo, or send a proposal with scope, timeline and cost.

items.q: Do you work with private companies, or only with government?
items.a: Both. We work with government offices, banks, telecom operators and private companies, on anything from a single system to a national programme.

items.q: Can we see a live demo?
items.a: Yes. Say what you would like to see in your message, and we will arrange a demo, in person or online.

items.q: Do you respond to tenders and RFPs?
items.a: Yes. Send us the tender details or documents, choose "Tender or RFP" in the form, and our team will get back to you.

items.q: What should I write in my message?
items.a: A few lines are enough: what you want to do, roughly how many people or records it covers, and when you need it. We will ask about the rest on the call.
